name: Maverick Hunter - Ultimate Armor X
desc:
2 Level 4 Machine monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can draw 1 card.
If this card is Xyz Summoned using at least 1 "X" monster as material, it gains these effects:
● Gains 1000 ATK.
● Negate the effects of cards this card destroys (either by battle or card effect).
(Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material; target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy those targets. You can only use this effect of "Maverick Hunter - Ultimate Armor X" once per turn.
